summary: The thread discusses adding a new Apache DataSketches HLL blob type to the Puffin spec to support NDV statistics. The discussion notes that V4 manifests are now Parquet-only and considers dropping ORC and Avro as data file formats. Interest from multiple contributors and alignment with SQL standards are noted, but the feature remains in the discussion phase. A pull request adds per-task scanDuration metrics to the Spark‑Iceberg reader, enabling measurement of scan time per task.
